settings.title: AM: Cleanse & prep
settings.text: Apply 2–3 drops to clean, damp skin after cleansing and before moisturizer or sunscreen.

settings.title: PM: Recovery layer
settings.text: Massage into the face and neck to support hydration and overnight repair.

settings.title: Weekly: Maintain
settings.text: Use the refill pack to keep your routine consistent and replenish the formula on schedule.

settings.question: Who is this serum duo for?
settings.answer: Ideal for dull, dehydrated, and early-aging skin that wants visible firming and a more supple finish.

settings.question: Can I use it with other actives?
settings.answer: Yes. It layers well after cleansing and before moisturizer. Avoid layering with heavy exfoliating acids in the same step.

settings.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes. The formula is designed to support the skin barrier and is suitable for daily use, though patch testing is recommended.

settings.question: Do I need both serums?
settings.answer: The duo is designed to work together for hydration and firming, but each serum can also be used individually depending on your skin goals.

settings.question: How quickly will I notice results?
settings.answer: Most customers notice smoother, more hydrated skin within 2–4 weeks of consistent use.
